title: Raven application metric record v1
description: One UTF-8 JSON object per newline in metrics.jsonl. This is the native Raven MetricReader input, with a stricter no-extra-fields producer profile. No schema marker is emitted in individual metric records.

t.description: Finite, nonnegative Unix epoch seconds in UTC.

metrics.description: Finite numeric application measurements. Names include units where useful, for example loss, throughput_items_per_s, accuracy_fraction.

progress.description: Native validation also enforces completed <= total. JSON Schema does not compare these sibling values.

$comment: Reject duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite numbers, invalid UTF-8, and records over 65536 bytes before schema validation. Native validation checks Python str.isprintable(), a stricter Unicode rule than this schema's control-character pattern. The default reader retains a bounded recent sample, not the full history.
